summary: Executor ran docker volume prune -f on the shared host Docker
solution: Forbid every docker prune in executor prompts; clean only by ID or noodara.test=true label

summary: Pre-spike plan 11-13 specified kill -TERM (fails under dash) and plain setsid (hides failures)
solution: Pass ADR override list to every executor; grep built scripts for kill -s TERM and setsid -w

summary: Docker Desktop crashed mid integration run (socket vanished)
solution: Run Ubuntu versions sequentially; restart with open -a Docker and rerun

summary: Subagents add Co-Authored-By trailers and use git stash/add -A despite CLAUDE.md
solution: Prohibit in each prompt; audit trailers, stash, fsck and parent-repo drift after every task

summary: boot-command integration test fails with EADDRINUSE :::3000 when another project's next dev holds port 3000
cause: apps/web dev is pinned to port 3000; myaws next-server was listening
solution: Free port 3000 before pnpm test:integration; consider a clear port-in-use precheck in the test

summary: Integration tests with describe.each over Ubuntu versions got 'setup failed: 500' in the 2nd block: env.ts/getDb() froze to the 1st block's stopped Postgres/Redis; fix = vi.resetModules() at the start of each block's beforeAll and import @noodara/domain/security + @noodara/ssh inside it (SecretValue private field). Fixed in runtime-build-logs (60b5598) and canary-deploy (e447169); task gates only ran 24.04 so it showed up only in NOODARA_TEST_UBUNTU=all / nightly
agent-flow review went stale right after record when the project is not the git toplevel
cause: worktreeSignature hashed toplevel-relative porcelain paths, so .agent-flow/ exclusions never matched and the review file write changed the signature
solution: agent-flow 68035ec scopes git status to the project root and strips --show-prefix; HEAD is still global, so commits elsewhere in the monorepo still invalidate reviews and gate caches

summary: Killing e2e/integration runs mid-flight leaves noodara.test-labelled Docker networks; harness afterAll strayNetworks() then fails other suites
cause: containers removed by hand but their labelled networks were not
solution: after killing runs remove containers AND networks with label noodara.test=true; never run e2e and integration concurrently (shared port 3000/Docker)

summary: Timing assertions measured with Date.now() flaked (4991ms < 5000ms readyTimeout) under long runs
cause: wall clock can be adjusted while ssh2 timers are monotonic

summary: Deep executors hit ~160k context and end without a report on UI tasks; several also left background Playwright runs after reporting
solution: require handoff files in every prompt, respawn fresh from the handoff, check pgrep playwright before gates, TaskStop stale agents

summary: Installer pin NOODARA_VERSION=v0.2.0-rc.1 pulled :v0.2.0-rc.1 and failed (exit 50) although .env held the normalized 0.2.0-rc.1
cause: Docker Compose gives the exported shell variable precedence over .env
solution: every compose call runs with the normalized version; .env written only after a successful pull (14-29)

summary: Executors left background Playwright/vitest runs, stacks on 3000/3100 and stress containers after reporting, breaking the next gate
cause: long runs started as background jobs; context guard blocked their cleanup
solution: require foreground runs and cleanup before the summary; orchestrator checks ports 3000/3100 and labels noodara.test/noodara.stress after every executor

summary: Phase gates passed locally but CI failed on migration-hygiene, site build and pnpm audit
cause: task gates never ran it-full, the apps/site build or pnpm audit
solution: gates it-db, site-build and audit added (14-21..14-23); close every phase with it-full, site build and audit

summary: Full pnpm test:integration failed 10 tests in engine-primitives and workspace-non-root after 16-02 removed DEPLOYING->SUCCESS
cause: legacy integration suites drive DeploymentRun.to manually and were not in any task gate
solution: add to('HEALTHCHECK') after startContainer (af7c935); when changing the deployment machine, grep tests/integration for .to( callers

summary: GitHub push protection blocked the rc.1 publish on fake sk_live_CANARY values in web secrets UI tests
cause: synthetic Stripe-shaped canaries in SecretRow/SecretsPanel tests match GitHub and gitleaks detectors
solution: allowlist the exact test paths in .gitleaks.toml; bypass push protection once with reason used_in_tests; prefer canaries that are not provider-shaped

summary: BSD sed -u splits a line from its newline, so two sed -u writers on one pipe mangle lines (logsWindow O/E tagging flaked on macOS)
cause: BSD sed -u writes line and newline separately; concurrent writers interleave
solution: tag with awk '{print "O " $0; fflush()}' (one write per line); verified on mawk 22.04/24.04

summary: Resetting Vitest modules per Ubuntu while retaining top-level SecretValue helpers causes SSH private-field reveal failure
cause: A top-imported SecretValue instance cannot be revealed by the freshly re-imported domain class after vi.resetModules (#raw class identity)
solution: Dynamically import domain security helpers after vi.resetModules beside SSH/application imports; keep module reset for env/getDb isolation across stopped PostgreSQL fixtures
